name: io.github.erayendes/asc-mcp
title: Heimdall — App Store Connect, TestFlight & StoreKit
description: App Store Connect, TestFlight & StoreKit 2. 786 tools in 14 profiles, narrow to 17.

packageArguments.description: Which slice of App Store Connect to serve. One of general, distribution, monetization, marketing, access, testflight, analytics, provisioning, game-center, app-clips, xcode-cloud, webhooks, background-assets — plus core (app lookup, tool search, screenshots), which runs next to them, or add --with-core to fold it into one server. Narrow further with a colon — monetization:subscription-offers is 17 tools instead of 186. Optional: without a profile argument, ASC-Default serves core + general + analytics in one process, forced read-only. Tools can be listed without credentials. For full use, run npx -y @erayendes/asc-mcp setup in a terminal and pick profiles. Unknown or retired names still serve only a setup notice.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API Key ID. Normally written for you by `npx -y @erayendes/asc-mcp setup`.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect Issuer ID (a UUID). Normally written for you by `setup`.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The .p8 private key as PEM text. Prefer `setup`, which stores it in the macOS Keychain instead of any config file; set this only where a Keychain is unavailable, such as CI.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the .p8 file, as an alternative to pasting its contents. Off macOS this is what `setup` records.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_BUNDLE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default app (bundle ID) for the StoreKit 2 transaction tools on the monetization profile; they also take the app's name.
